costs.measured: 8 run(s) of the whole selection on Apple M3 Max, in the case set's own order, the largest each count reached
costs.contrasted: 8 run(s) of each case on its own on Apple M3 Max, nothing before it on the device, the largest each count reached

times.measured: 8 round(s) of the whole selection, in the case set's own order, each round on a fresh device, our shader cache carried over between the cases of a round; a figure is the median of the rounds' own medians; Metal's leg ran at a one-minute load average of 3.18 and ours at 2.63; the legs run one after the other, so the per-call margin is judged only when both are 26.0 or under and within 2.0x of each other
